scenarios.prompt: A character enters a water volume, transitions to surface locomotion, dives if allowed, then exits at a ledge. Define volume state, buoyancy and optional breath ownership.

criteria.volume: Water enter/exit/surface data drives logical state instead of render-height guesses.
criteria.ownership: Swim owns water traversal; breath/resource, camera solid collision and fall consequences remain explicitly delegated or published.
criteria.evidence: Tests shallow/deep entry, dive boundary, warnings, blocked exit and quick re-entry without stuck state.
